title: Iranian hackers shut down UK power plant for 4 days
summary: This news article reports on Iranian hackers successfully breaching and shutting down a UK power plant for four days, highlighting the vulnerability of critical national infrastructure to state-sponsored cyber attacks and the potential real-world consequences of such operations.
problem_solved: This article reports rather than solves a problem—it illustrates the growing threat of cyber attacks on critical infrastructure and the urgent need for improved cybersecurity defenses in the energy sector.
why_valuable: The article raises awareness about the serious risks posed by nation-state actors to essential services and underscores the importance of protecting critical infrastructure from sophisticated cyber threats.
